verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 product page says NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant running on the RTX PC that "helps you tune, control, and optimize your system," so the product ecosystem does ship a built-in assistant users can hand tasks to. That support rests on a single marketing sentence, and the "Project" naming suggests the assistant is experimental. Its scope also appears limited to system tuning rather than general task delegation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what tasks G-Assist can perform, evidence of multi-step or agentic delegation beyond system tuning, any independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.
